text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of Satono Diamond's
planned
staff appreciation event!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here! The event you've all
been waiting
for—the staff appreciation
race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Our first group of racers is already
bursting with
energy as they wait by the
gate for the race to
start!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your help, everyone!
Let's have
lots of fun today!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you too for creating such a
precious
opportunity to show everyone
our gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I won't be losing this race. ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I won't be losin' this either! I'm gonna give my thanks to the staff with my overwhelmin' victory!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please! The academy's staff members do
so much
for us on a daily basis...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We want to hold a staff appreciation
race for
them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day, Satono Diamond
and the
others have been working hard
to organize
today's event.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And lastly, the twelfth event will be a

1,200-meter turf race. There, now the
race
schedule is all done!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll go distribute the invitations to
everyone now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, but I'll be fine! I actually
want to hand
out these invitations in
person.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for always keeping everything
clean
and in order. I hope you'll attend
so that we might
show you the fruits of
our labor.

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Management Staff
text_block_list.text:
You did all this for us?! We'll definitely
come
cheer you on with all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We wouldn't be able to build ourselves
up for our
races properly without the
meals you lovingly
make for us!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
It's more than enough thanks just
hearing that
from you. We're greatly
looking forward to the
event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After all of Satono Diamond's worrying
over how
to thank the academy's staff,
the answer turned
out to be plain and
simple.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all once again for coming to
today's
event!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All of us here passed through the gates
of this
academy holding a dream close
to our hearts...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's due to the support we receive from
every
single person working here at the
academy that
we are able to chase our
dreams every day, free
of worry.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We're bolstered by all the work you do.
And to
show just how important that
work is...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please watch us in this event we've
prepared for
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer! You came to watch too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, I was!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Listening to everyone's cheers has made
me
realize yet again just how much
everyone
supports us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for all your help!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Allow me to congratulate you on
a
successful event as well. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It warms my heart to see all the staff
enjoying
themselves so much!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way... Would you two happen to
have any
plans after today's races?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
After learning of today's event, the
director
mentioned wanting to show her
own appreciation
to the academy's
students and staff.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing major, but she offered to
hold a
celebratory after-party. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That would be incredible! We'd be
able to
spend even more time talking
with all the staff!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But before that, I have to give it my all
in the
next race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Dia! It's almost our turn to run!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Right! Coming!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Satono Diamond's staff

appreciation event ends in a roaring
success!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Dia, there you are! Hurry up, it's
almost our
turn to run!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You gotta make sure you're nice and
ready so
you'll be at your best during
the race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll be there in just a second!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Please watch me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run my best and show
everyone the
extent of my gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The excitement in the venue reaches a
fever pitch
as the heated races continue.
Naturally, the
runners hold a winning
concert to close off the
event.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And finally for today, we'd like to pour
all our
feelings into this song for you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I hope our feelings reach you all! Please enjoy our performance of We Are Dreamers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond and the other
Umamusume sing
with such power and
emotion that their voices
resound far
and wide for all to hear.
